historical_limits: The raw old index has named Easy/Hard labels without independent numeric readback in every underlying receipt. Previously withdrawn boolean-Hard labels remain unqualified. No historical coverage counts or mode labels are promoted here.
final_test_requirements: Actual numeric difficulty/character/alternate readback; legal controller stream and bound exact ROM.
Every identity clears1-1; preserve requested main and shortcut route scope.
Each applicable collectible must emerge, become collectible, be picked up and exercise its acquired action or passive.
Check refill/cap/refusal, consumed-ammo state, damage/reacquisition and cleanup where applicable.
Review actual PPU/animation/scroll/block effects, sound and draw cadence.
Direct-state/CPU components and source ownership alone never mark a physical lifecycle complete.
native_item_case_expansion: Native family details remain in each source-backed row. Individual executable case enumeration is still required; this index is not a completed test run.
